notes: Tuning + Tip Charger auto-connect. The Tip Charger / display now auto-connects over any common USB-to-RS232 converter (CP210x, FTDI, Prolific, CH340) - previously only CP210x was recognized - so the Tuning page gets its live Power/Temp/Vac feed with no manual Connect. The connect check still requires the device to actually stream, so a non-streaming adapter is ignored, not driven. Tuning page also redraws immediately when opened.
